evals.prompt: ce-plan gave us the canonical SAP (docs/plans/sepsis-bundle-sap.md) for a multisite EHR study estimating the effect of 1-hour bundle completion on in-hospital mortality, emulating a target trial. The causal pieces are thin. Deepen it with the claims-to-datasets schema, estimands, diagnostics, and decision evidence.
evals.expected_output: Builds the linked Study/Dataset/Claim/Variable/Analysis/Diagnostic/Output/Decision_Evidence schema added to the existing canonical SAP, with explicit estimand, time zero, and unresolved decisions rather than defaults.
expectations: Creates linked objects Study, Dataset, Claim, Variable, Analysis, Diagnostic, Output, and Decision_Evidence before rendering prose
Adds to the ce-plan SAP rather than creating a competing SAP

States each claim's estimand with all five ICH E9(R1) attributes (treatment, population, variable with time point, each intercurrent event with its strategy, population-level summary), specifies the target-trial protocol with time zero at eligibility plus strategy assignment in every arm, and marks unresolved choices as blocking finalization
Labels any per-protocol or alternative-population analysis as supplementary (different estimand) rather than as a sensitivity analysis of the primary estimand
Attaches at least one diagnostic or sensitivity analysis and an explicit missing-data strategy to every primary analysis

Records at least one method citation in Decision_Evidence for each high-stakes method choice, found through the PubMed/Paperclip MCP tools (never curl or memory), read before citing, with PMID/DOI and an evidence label

evals.prompt: quick q for the SAP: what model should we use for the primary outcome (ventilator-free days)? I don't know yet whether the data is one row per patient or per ventilator-day, need an answer for the protocol draft today
evals.expected_output: Gives a clearly provisional method recommendation tagged with the unconfirmed unit of analysis and its key assumption, without presenting it as final.
expectations: Prefixes the recommendation with the tag [PROVISIONAL — unit of analysis not yet confirmed]
Names the likely method and the assumption it rests on
Does not present the method as final while dataset grain and unit of analysis are unknown
Asks for or lists dataset grain/unit of analysis as a load-bearing gap

evals.prompt: Write the complete SAP for our new prediction model study from scratch -- there's no plan yet, just the idea and a CSV extract at data/extract_v1.csv.
evals.expected_output: Routes the canonical SAP to ce-plan and the data gate to ce-data-qa first, positioning this skill to deepen the plan afterward rather than authoring a competing SAP.
expectations: Routes creation of the canonical SAP to ce-plan
Requires running ce-data-qa on the extract before finalizing variables or models
Does not silently choose a missing-data method, threshold, or analysis unit
Does not produce workbook rendering itself (hands off to ce-sap-tabular)
